Alerts and advisories

Find the latest in cyber security alerts and advice

All alerts and advisories

16 Oct 2025
Alert rating: Critical

Multiple high-severity vulnerabilities in F5 products and incident impacting F5

F5 has released multiple security advisories affecting BIG-IP, BIG-IP Next, F5OS, and Silverline products. The most critical issues include vulnerabilities in SCP/SFTP, SSL/TLS, HTTP/2, and TMM components, with several rated high (CVSS up to 8.8). Exploitation could allow remote code execution, data exposure, or denial of service.

Audience focus: Small & medium businesses Organisations & Critical Infrastructure Government
07 Oct 2025
Alert rating: Critical

Critical vulnerability in Oracle E-Business Suite

ASD’s ACSC recommends organisations update affected products to the latest versions and follow the advice detailed in the Oracle Security Advisory.

Audience focus: Small & medium businesses Organisations & Critical Infrastructure Government
26 Sep 2025
Alert rating: Critical

Multiple vulnerabilities affecting Cisco ASA 5500-X Series devices

The Australian Signals Directorate’s Australian Cyber Security Centre (ASD's ACSC) is aware of multiple vulnerabilities impacting Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) 5500-X Series models that are running Cisco ASA Software or Cisco Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Software.

Cisco reports active exploitation of these vulnerabilities globally. ASD’s ACSC has also observed targeting in Australia.

Audience focus: Small & medium businesses Organisations & Critical Infrastructure Government
10 Sep 2025
Alert rating: High

Ongoing active exploitation of SonicWall SSL VPNs in Australia (CVE-2024-40766)

The Australian Signals Directorate’s (ASD’s) Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) is aware of ongoing active exploitation of a critical vulnerability in SonicWall SSL VPNs.

Audience focus: Small & medium businesses Organisations & Critical Infrastructure
28 Aug 2025
Advisory

Countering Chinese State-Sponsored Actors Compromise of Networks Worldwide to Feed Global Espionage System

This joint cyber security advisory gives vital insights on People’s Republic of China (PRC) state-sponsored cyber threat actors, how they gain and maintain persistent access, and the capabilities they have. It provides threat hunting guidance and mitigation strategies to help safeguard your networks.

Audience focus: Organisations & Critical Infrastructure Government
27 Aug 2025
Alert rating: Critical

Multiple vulnerabilities affecting NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway devices

The Australian Signals Directorate’s Australian Cyber Security Centre (ASD’s ACSC) is aware of multiple vulnerabilities (CVE-2025-7775, CVE-2025-7776 & CVE-2025-8424) affecting NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) products.

Audience focus: Organisations & Critical Infrastructure Government

Think you might be impacted?

Cybercrime is the use of a computer or online network to commit crimes such as fraud, online image abuse, identity theft or threats and intimidation.

You can report cybercrime to the police via ReportCyber.
